map.📚 深度解析：材料耐热三项检测判定（耐热/老化保持/安全）: 📚 Deep Dive: Three-Item Material Test (Heat Resistance / Aging Retention / Safety)
map.材料耐老化自检：按耐热温度、老化后强度保持率、安全等级三项判定: Material aging self-check: judge by three items — heat-resistant temperature, post-aging strength retention, safety class
map.耐久评估：保持率反映长期强度留存: Durability assessment: retention reflects long-term strength reserve
map.逐项判定：耐热温度≥150℃、老化后强度保持率≥80%、安全等级≤2 级；三项均: Item-by-item: heat-resistant temperature ≥ 150℃, post-aging strength retention ≥ 80%, safety class ≤ 2; all three satisfied = pass. Low retention signals thermal-aging embrittlement.
map.耐热 160℃（≥150 ✓）、保持率 85%（≥80 ✓）、安全等级 1 级（: Heat resistance 160℃ (≥150 ✓), retention 85% (≥80 ✓), safety class 1 (≤2 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If retention drops to 75% it fails, insufficient durability.
map.为材料燃烧安全分级（如 1 级最优、2 级可接受），≤2 表示阻燃/安全达标；高: It is a material combustibility safety classification (e.g., class 1 best, class 2 acceptable); ≤2 means flame-retardant/safety compliant; highly flammable materials must be restricted in use.
map.耐热温度越高越好？: Is higher heat-resistant temperature always better?
map.越高耐温性越强，但须结合材料其他性能与成本；关键是达到使用环境温度并保留足够老化: Higher means stronger heat resistance, but must be balanced with other properties and cost; the key is reaching the service temperature and retaining sufficient post-aging strength.
map.耐热试验需逐级升温，观察变形和性能变化: Heat-resistance tests require stepwise temperature rise, observing deformation and property changes
map.老化试验需模拟自然环境条件，加速老化: Aging tests require simulating natural-environment conditions with accelerated aging
